text:
April (docs): short thread: prepping migration note for retiring /v1/invoke. single-page guide, tiny snippets, and an FAQ line for Dedicated customers. public notice target: Sep 1.

Ken (sdk): I'll add a 6-line JS mapping and a one-line curl. keep it copy/paste. will note model@pin recommendation.

Rhea (prod): include fallback behavior: missing model@version -> route to alias, emit metric fallback.model_alias_used. add canary header example: X-Canary: 1.

Ken (sdk): JS snippet:
```js
// v1 -> v2 minimal map
const v1 = { model: "rwd-core", input: "hello" }
const v2 = { model: `${v1.model}@2024-09-01`, input: v1.input, meta: v1.meta || {} }
client.responses.create(v2, { headers: { 'X-Migrate-From':'v1' } })
```

Ken (sdk): curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-core@2024-09-01","input":"hello"}'

April (docs): add checklist: token counts, embedding dims, smoke test (50 prompts). note: if you relied on implicit aliasing expect embed dim diffs.

Sam (legal): wording ok; add line: "No customer data will be deleted or moved as part of this change." Enterprise customers: coordinate with account teams.

pr-bot: Draft PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6001 (migration guide + snippets).

April (docs): action items: Ken -> drop final snippets into PR (today), Rhea -> console banner & runbook update (by Aug 20), Sam -> enterprise notice check (48h). I'll publish notice once PR merges. :sparkles:
